body_text:
An occurrence of a variable is *bound* if it lies within the
scope of a quantifier that binds that variable; otherwise it is
*free*. A formula with no free variables is a sentence and
therefore has a truth value in a fixed interpretation. A
formula with free variables denotes a condition on possible
assignments to those variables. Renaming a bound variable does
not change meaning, provided the new name does not capture a
formerly free occurrence.
